JAMMING.gloss: deliberate radiation or reflection of electromagnetic energy for the purpose of…
JAMMING.definition: Deliberate radiation or reflection of electromagnetic energy for the purpose of disrupting enemy use of electronic devices or systems.

IMAM.gloss: the man who leads prayers in a mosque
IMAM.definition: (Islam) the man who leads prayers in a mosque; for Shiites an imam is a recognized authority on Islamic theology and law and a spiritual guide.

MAN.gloss: an adult person who is male
MAN.definition: An adult person who is male (as opposed to a woman).
MAN.example: There were two women and six men on the bus.

AIM.gloss: point or cause to go towards
AIM.definition: Point or cause to go (blows, weapons, or objects such as photographic equipment) towards.
AIM.example: Please don't aim at your little brother!

MIN.gloss: a unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour
MIN.definition: A unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour.

MAG.gloss: a periodic publication containing pictures and stories and articles of interest to…
MAG.definition: A periodic publication containing pictures and stories and articles of interest to those who purchase it or subscribe to it.
MAG.example: It takes several years before a magazine starts to break even or make money.

GIN.gloss: strong liquor flavored with juniper berries
GIN.definition: Strong liquor flavored with juniper berries.
